name: Khon Kaen International Marathon (22nd ed.)
short_description: The Khon Kaen International Marathon (22nd edition) takes place January 10, 2027, in Khon Kaen, Thailand, offering marathon and half marathon distances.
ai_summary: The Khon Kaen International Marathon is the 22nd edition of this annual road race, scheduled for January 10, 2027, in Khon Kaen, Thailand. The event offers both a full marathon distance of 42.195 km and a half marathon distance of 21.1 km, giving runners a choice based on their preferred challenge.
pros: Cool, dry January air: 16°C with an 11°C dew point at the 2026 marathon start
Seven-hour marathon limit with checkpoints at about 10 minutes per km
Water about every 2 km, with electrolyte and fruit at five points on the marathon
Free shuttles from the airport, stations and hotels, plus free tent areas
AIMS-certified course with prize money and a Top 100 award
cons: 3am marathon start, with hotel shuttle buses from 1.30am
Congested early kilometres in the shorter races, with walkers near the front
Saturday fun run was shortened at the last minute from 5.4 km to 4.8 km in 2026
No refunds, even if the race is postponed

faqs.question: When is the Khon Kaen International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Khon Kaen International Marathon, now in its 22nd edition, is scheduled to take place on January 10, 2027. The race is held in Khon Kaen, Thailand, and this date marks the confirmed occurrence of the event for participants planning to register and attend.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Khon Kaen International Marathon offers two distances for participants to choose from: a full marathon at 42.195 km, which serves as the primary distance, and a half marathon option at 21.1 km. This gives runners flexibility depending on their fitness level and goals.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The Khon Kaen International Marathon is held in Khon Kaen, Thailand, which serves as both the venue and host city for the event. This location has hosted the race across its many editions, with the 22nd edition set for January 10, 2027.
